prompt: Our admins find range checks that compare the same value twice hard to read. Please add between(value, low, high) for numbers and timestamps, so a rule can say between(order.total, 50, 100) or between(order.placedAt, start, end). Wire it up and add tests like the other built-ins.
oracle: When we add between, the low end counts and the high end does not, so between(10, 0, 10) is false and between(0, 0, 10) is true.
